features.title: Attach named outside directories and git repositories to a thread
features.summary: Save a reference (a directory read in place, or a git URL shallow-cloned under $DSH_HOME/references), attach it to a Session with /reference or the reference_* tools, and name every attached reference with its absolute path in that Session's runtime context.
failureModes: A relative path, a missing directory or a ref on a directory is refused before anything is saved.
A failed clone (bad URL, ref or credentials) saves nothing and names the git error.
Removing a reference detaches it from every Session and deletes only its own clone, never a directory.

externalDependencies.boundary: Fixed-argv `git clone --depth 1` with a five-minute timeout and terminal prompts disabled.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Real temporary git repositories cloned over file:// in src/references.test.ts; no git mock is used.
